summary: Ventas Realty, Limited Partnership filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of senior notes in an undisclosed aggregate principal amount, fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by parent Ventas, Inc. Pricing, coupon, maturity and redemption terms are left blank, confirming a preliminary, pre-pricing document. Notes are unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt, offered via J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, Citigroup, PNC Capital Markets and SMBC Nikko, with no exchange listing. This is a routine investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
